title: Formalization of norm-variation of multiple ergodic averages for commuting transformations
abstract: This is a Lean 4 formalization of norm-variation of multiple ergodic averages for commuting transformations,  including Tao's norm-convergence theorem. At the heart of the argument is an explicit real-variable estimate for twisted multilinear averages. This formalization is based on the blueprint available at arXiv:2608.27321. The statements of the main theorems have been hand-formalized,  while the proof was autoformalized during a one-week period using coding agents under human supervision.  This produced roughly 107k lines of code (excluding comments and blank lines) and includes proofs of several  prerequisite theorems currently not in mathlib such as multilinear complex interpolation,  the Calderón transference principle, and properties of Wiener space functions.
